title: IngressTLS
description: TLS configuration for an Ingress, specifying a Secret containing the certificate and key for terminating HTTPS connections on port 443.

hosts.description: Hosts covered by the TLS certificate. Must match hosts defined in the certificate's Subject Alternative Names.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret in the same namespace containing the TLS certificate (tls.crt) and key (tls.key).
